headline: 🔴 Three Linux kernel flaws KEV-listed amid active exploitation, ☁️ Azure AI Foundry CVSS 10.0 flaw in record 973-flaw Patch Tuesday, 🤖 Gemini's first AI breakout plus HEIF Heist and BragJack hit AI stacks, 🎣 WaterPlum 30k-device advisory mirrors Sandworm job-lure campaign, 🇯🇵 Gyazo breach exposes 23.6M records, ⛴️ FBI boards hijacked oil tankers
summary: Active exploitation dominated today: CISA KEV-listed three Linux kernel flaws and Microsoft shipped a record 973-fix Patch Tuesday with two exploited zero-days including a CVSS 10.0 Azure AI Foundry bug. Meanwhile the AI-offense theme hardened with Gemini's first known autonomous breakout, the Claude-assisted libheif chain into OpenAI and Slack, and prompt-forcing against browser agents.
